output: We can offer two weeks of free storage, but we can’t cover the full six months.
Before departure, enable offline mode while connected to Wi-Fi to download your selected route. Live detours are unavailable offline.
A reservation holds your workshop place but excludes materials: buy the $18 kit or bring the items on the supply list. Buying a kit does not reserve a workshop place.
Keep the original receipt. A photo is acceptable for registration, but warranty claims require the paper copy.
Saturday’s outdoor screening may move indoors if the forecast remains unfavorable. The final location will be posted at noon Friday. Tickets remain valid at either location.
Run Preview before importing. It flags missing dates and duplicate order numbers without changing records. Fix all flagged rows in the source file before selecting Import.
The replacement wheels are included in the shipment. The axle wasn’t part of the original order, so it isn’t included. I can send a separate quote for it.
If you live within city limits, you can apply for the discount if you are 65 or older or have a current disability transit pass.

Your saved searches have moved to the new dashboard and are ready to open. Their alerts have not yet migrated, so continue changing alert settings in the old dashboard. We expect to migrate alerts next week, subject to verification.

Staff may borrow a meeting-room key for a confirmed booking. Return it to reception before leaving the building. If reception is closed, use the locked key box beside its desk. Do not leave keys in the meeting room.

Open your invitation link within 48 hours, then choose a password and enter the six-digit code sent by email. If the link has expired, ask the inviter for a new one.

Administrators assign workspace access separately. You may log in successfully and still see an empty workspace list; ask an administrator to assign your access.

The main gravel path from Mill Bridge to the old ferry landing has reopened. The lower boardwalk and the short staircase from the landing to the water remain closed. Follow the entrance route map and stay outside the temporary barriers. There is no confirmed date for the remaining repairs.

Water levels can change quickly, and the duty ranger may close the path without notice, including during heavy rain. Check the entrance board: its closure notices take priority over older reopening announcements.

Wheelchair users and visitors with strollers can reach the picnic area from Mill Bridge without steps. Beyond it, a short section has loose gravel and a steep cross-slope. The full route’s accessibility assessment is not complete. The accessible toilet in the bridge car park opens from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.; the ferry landing toilet is closed.

Dogs are welcome on the open path on a lead. From March 1 through July 31, dogs are excluded from the marked nesting zone beside the reed beds, even on a lead. You can still walk your dog along the main path beside the zone.

Cycling is allowed between Mill Bridge and the picnic area; give pedestrians priority. Beyond the picnic area, dismount and walk your bicycle to the ferry landing. This applies to electric and conventional bicycles. Mobility aids are not bicycles under this rule.

Parking at Mill Bridge costs $3 for up to two hours or $5 for the day. Machines accept cards only. Walking admission is free, and visitors arriving on foot do not need a parking ticket.

For a guided visit, a local volunteer group offers a free walk at 10 a.m. on the first Sunday of each month. Register to reserve one of twelve places. Registration does not reserve parking or waive parking charges.

From September 1, request photographic collection access through the collection portal. If you cannot use the portal, staff can help you complete a request by phone. Email requests received before September 1 remain in the queue; do not resubmit them. Later email requests will receive instructions for using the portal.

Provide your contact details, a brief research purpose and the collection reference if you know it. If you do not know the reference, give as much descriptive information as possible instead.

Staff first identify the item and check for a usable scan. Existing scans normally take up to five working days to supply after identification. New scanning has no fixed turnaround during the conservation backlog.

The conservation team decides whether a print can be handled safely. If scanning risks damage, the collections team will explain any available alternatives, such as an older reference image, a catalog description or supervised viewing. These depend on the item’s condition and restrictions and are not guaranteed. Where possible, staff will explain the specific reason for a restriction.

Requests containing personal information about living people may need a separate review before access is granted. There is no promised deadline for these additional reviews. Conservation, privacy and rights checks are separate; clearing one does not clear the others.

Reference scans are free for individual research requests of up to ten images. Larger requests are reviewed for staffing time and may carry a service charge. You must accept the quote before chargeable work begins. The ten-image allowance applies to the total request, not each submission. Staff may ask about related submissions to establish the total.

Access for private study does not grant publication permission or change ownership. Before using an image in a book, website, exhibition or commercial product, you are responsible for obtaining any necessary permissions. Catalog rights information is incomplete: “no rights holder recorded” does not mean an image is in the public domain. Staff can share recorded information but cannot promise to identify every rights holder. The museum can grant permission only for rights it controls. Paying for scanning does not buy a publication license or transfer copyright.

The east lift is out of service; the west lift remains available. At 8:10 a.m., the east lift stopped between floors with two passengers inside. The service team opened the doors at 8:27 a.m., and both passengers left without reported injury.

A worn door sensor was found, but the cause of the stoppage has not been confirmed. A replacement sensor is on order. The lift will remain unavailable until checks are complete; we cannot yet give a return-to-service date.

Do not commit to installers for October 5 yet: delivery is not consistently confirmed. Operations says delivery is booked for October 4, but the supplier portal checked later lists October 4 as estimated dispatch, with delivery pending. The purchase order says the delivery date is to be agreed.

Ask the supplier and Operations to reconcile these records and confirm the delivery date in writing. Use that confirmation to decide whether the goods will be available for installation on October 5.

We recommend keeping the weekday shuttle through November, subject to budget committee approval. Average weekday ridership was 42 in September and 39 in October. The shuttle also serves the clinic on Tuesdays, when there is no public bus.

Weekend ridership was not measured, so these data do not support extending weekend service. We propose counting weekend riders for four weeks before deciding.
I found no duplicate imports, so my earlier suspicion is not supported. A timezone filter excludes seven rows. I’ll compare the stored timestamps with the filter boundaries to investigate why.
Four of the five brochures are converted to accessible HTML. Three have passed keyboard checks; I’ll check the fourth next, then convert the fifth.
Rendering broke the page numbering. I’ll fix it and check the rendered handbook before asking for your approval to upload.
Fixed the Safari focus problem locally. Keyboard checks pass in Safari and Firefox, and all 38 automated tests pass. The change has not been committed, pushed or deployed.

I missed the 3 p.m. deadline—sorry. The main report summary is drafted, but two conflicting appendix totals are blocking the financial comparison. I’ll compare the appendix calculations to reconcile them.

Renamed 11 of 12 image files using the approved mapping. `cover-old.png` could not be renamed to `cover.png` because that destination already exists. No file was overwritten.

Details: [rename receipt](/workspace/output/rename-receipt.json).
The counts reconcile: 4,912 imported records plus eight excluded by the documented archived-status rule account for the expected 4,920. Export generation is still running.

Choose Cedar: it supports the five editors you need for $18/month. Birch costs $12/month but allows only one editor. Pine’s price and editor limit are unavailable, so its suitability remains unresolved.
Our records show the projector was returned late, so a $25 late fee has been applied. If the return record is incorrect, please send your drop-off receipt by Friday.
After an unnecessarily elaborate procurement journey, the new office kettle is here. It boils water. We have tested this revolutionary capability. Please empty it before the weekend.
Sports day is Thursday, May 16, at 9 a.m. Yesterday’s newsletter incorrectly said Wednesday. Sorry for the error.
I don’t know the right thing to say. I loved how your dad always made room at the table. I can bring dinner Thursday, if that would help.
This clay container kept food cooler without electricity. Water seeped through tiny pores in the clay. As the water evaporated, it carried heat away from the food inside.

The three primary buttons have identical color and size, and testers repeatedly chose Cancel instead of Save. Give Save a strong filled color and make Cancel a neutral outlined button so the actions are easier to distinguish.
We’ve got a queue this morning, folks. If you’re only dropping off a form, pop it in the blue tray and you’re good to go. Payments still need the counter.

The new reminder subject line got 41 opens out of 100; the old one got 44 out of 100. We haven’t run a statistical analysis, so this doesn’t establish a meaningful difference. We’ll keep the old line for now and test a different send time next week.
The reduced rate applies to bookings of 3–6 nights. Seven-night bookings use the weekly rate; two-night bookings use the standard rate.
Editors can suggest changes, but only owners can approve publication. An owner’s approval covers that version only. Future versions and changes to access permissions need separate authorization.

Lab A reported 12 mg/L and Lab B reported 19 mg/L. The samples were collected on different dates using different methods. Without a method comparison, the results do not establish the reason for the difference or that either measurement is wrong.
Do not restart the pump unless both conditions are met: the inlet valve is open and the pressure gauge reads below 20 psi. If either condition is not met, call the supervisor.

Enrollment lets you request a travel grant but does not guarantee an award. Awards depend on available funds and approval of your proposed trip. Booking before approval does not increase your priority.

Outages fell from 10 to 6 across two one-month observation periods after the maintenance change. That decline does not establish that maintenance caused it: the second month had milder weather, and usage was not recorded.
We will replace defective stitching reported within one year of purchase. This guarantee excludes fabric fading, accidental damage, and normal wear. Keep proof of purchase.

Do not hire either candidate yet. Hiring requires a passed practical test and two satisfactory references. Candidate A passed the test but still needs to supply two references for assessment. Candidate B supplied both references but did not pass the test; supplying references alone does not establish that they are satisfactory.
